module password.strength
  purpose: Classify password strength.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: Password strength classification.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Classify a password as Weak, Fair, or Strong.
  example: classify(password: "abc") is Weak
  example: classify(password: "password1") is Fair
  example: classify(password: "MyP@ssw0rd123") is Strong

  let length be password.length
  
  if length is at least 12 then
    let has_letter be password.matches(raw "[a-zA-Z]")
    let has_digit be password.matches(raw "[0-9]")
    let has_other be password.matches(raw "[^a-zA-Z0-9]")
    
    if has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
      return Strong
    end
  end
  
  if length is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  end
  
  return Weak
end
```
